title: DripStoneRecipeFIX
description: This Mod adds a recipe where dripstone blocks can be turned into dripstones.
body:
# 🪨 DripstoneRecipeFix
### *Finally – get the most out of your Dripstone Blocks.*

> A small but handy mod that adds the one crafting recipe Minecraft was always missing.

---

## 📖 Description

Ever found yourself with a stack of Dripstone Blocks and no way to turn them back into individual Pointed Dripstones? This small but handy mod adds a single crafting recipe that lets you do exactly that.

Simple, clean, and straight to the point.

---

## 🔧 Added Recipe

| Input | Output |
|---|---|
| 1x Dripstone Block | 4x Pointed Dripstone |

Place a **Dripstone Block** in your crafting grid and get **4x Pointed Dripstones** back – no more wasted resources!

---

## 🧱 Compatibility

| Property | Info |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.21.1 / 1.21.8 |
| **Mod Loader** | NeoForge |
| **Dependencies** | None |
